first.rationale: The immediate competitive loss is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, where targeted pricing has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. I would verify both that evidence and the competing onboarding evidence before committing, and run only a tightly targeted, time-bounded offer because discounting can impair long-term unit economics and customer quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the self-serve onboarding flow. The verified prior result directly addresses the current completion decline, improving completion by 13%, reducing time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increasing 30-day retention by 3%; earlier evidence also found durable activation improvement from simpler signup. This targets both deteriorating onboarding and activation while improving, rather than trading off, downstream customer value. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified retention decline makes it unsuitable for sustainable qualified revenue.
